description: Set HEAD_DIM to 64 so the model uses 12 heads of dim 64 instead of 6 heads of dim 128.
Change ADAM_BETAS from (0.8, 0.95) to (0.8, 0.99) for smoother second-moment estimates.
Halve TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2**18 so grad accumulation is 2 and the model gets more optimizer steps within the 300 s budget.
Halve TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE again to 2**17 (grad accumulation 1) for many more optimizer steps in the 300 s budget.
Set WARMUP_RATIO to 0.03 so the learning rate ramps up linearly over the first 3% of the time budget.
Set FINAL_LR_FRAC to 0.05 so the learning rate ends at 5% of its initial value instead of exactly zero.
Multiply the RMS-normalized q by a fixed 1.2 to sharpen attention logits.

description: Muon momentum ramps 0.85 to 0.95 over 300 steps, holds 0.95, then decays linearly to 0.9 during the warmdown phase.
Halve lm_head init std from 0.001 to 0.0005 so initial logits are smaller.
Set WARMDOWN_RATIO to 0.3 so the model trains at peak LR for 70% of the time budget before the linear warmdown.
Set WINDOW_PATTERN to "SSSS" (last layer is still forced full) so all but the final layer use half-context attention, which speeds up attention and gives more steps.
Set WARMDOWN_RATIO to 0.7 so the learning rate decays linearly over the last 70% of the time budget.
Raise MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.05 for the Muon matrix parameters.
Set WINDOW_PATTERN to "SSSSSSSL" so only the final layer uses full attention, which cuts attention cost.
